meta_title: A J W Decorating | Painter & Decorator Nottingham
meta_description: A J W Decorating brings expert interior and exterior painting to Nottingham homes. Reliable, professional results with a personal touch. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Painter & Decorator — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting that transforms your Nottingham home. Meticulous prep, expert finish, fair prices.
services_heading: Interior & Exterior Painting Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From a single room refresh to a full house exterior, A J W Decorating handles every project with precision and pride.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. Proper preparation, premium paints, and finishes that last. We move furniture and protect your floors.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior walls, fascias, and soffits. We use trade-grade paints rated for UK weather and include scaffolding where needed for safety.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Redecorating
services.desc: Specialist finishes for moisture-prone rooms. We prep and prime properly to prevent peeling, and use bathroom-grade paints and sealers.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, window frames, and built-in wardrobes. Hand-finished to a smooth, durable coat that looks sharp for years.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Hanging, pattern matching, and removal of old paper. From traditional designs to modern statement walls — we work with your chosen aesthetic.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Offices, retail units, and rental properties. We work flexibly around your schedule and ensure minimal disruption to your business.

about_pullquote: Good decorating is about getting the prep right — that's where the difference lives.
about_para_1: A J W Decorating was founded on a simple principle: treat every job, big or small, with the same care and attention. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Nottingham and Calverton for reliable, honest work. Our focus has always been on proper preparation, quality materials, and finishes that stand the test of time.
about_para_2: Customers come back to us because we turn up on time, explain what we're doing, and leave your home spotless when we're done. We don't cut corners on prep work — that's why our paint lasts and looks so good. Whether it's a small bathroom refresh or a full exterior renovation, we take the same professional approach.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About A J W Decorating

reviews.text: Adrian came to quote for our hallway and stairs. Fair price, turned up when he said he would, and the work was immaculate. Took him two days, protected everything, and left us with a really clean finish. Highly recommended — will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had our whole kitchen redecorated during lockdown. Adrian was professional, courteous, and worked around our family without complaint. The finish on the units is flawless. Cost was reasonable and he stuck to the timescale. Top job.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Exterior of our bungalow needed attention — woodwork, gutters, the lot. Adrian sorted scaffolding, prepared everything properly, and used quality exterior paint. It looks fresh and new. Good communication throughout, fair price. Very happy.
reviews.author: Robert P.
